title: Magellan radar finds metallic snow on Venus

tellings.quote: in fact, I was at NASA when the Mellan probe was mapping Venus using radar.

plain: In the 1990s Magellan, a NASA space probe that mapped the surface of Venus with radar, found what looked like metallic snow on the planet's mountaintops. The physicist Kevin Knuth, who calls himself a former NASA insider, tells it from his own time there: "I was at NASA when the Magellan probe was mapping Venus using radar." He brings it up as an example of a strange finding from NASA's own data.
